severity.HIGH: RED / ABSENT from any source; AST SYNTAX, DUPDEF, UNREACH, BAREEXC, PSDUPFN, PSDOCSTR, COMPILE, TAILAPI, UNREADABLE (a target panorama could not read)

BAREEXC.desc: 裸 except:(連 KeyboardInterrupt / SystemExit 都吞)

COMPILE.desc: ast.parse 過、compile 不過(例:加速橋注在 from __future__ 前,Z226)

MUTDEF.desc: 可變預設引數([] / {} / set() / dict() / list())——跨呼叫共用同一個物件

PINVER.desc: 釘死版號(違尾版律 L54)

PSDOCSTR.desc: PowerShell 函式本體開頭是三引號字串(不是註解,是回傳值;LL182)

PSDUPFN.desc: PowerShell 同名 function 定義兩次(後者蓋掉前者;LL283)

SWALLOW.desc: except 本體只有 pass/continue/...(例外被吞、沒有任何看得見的改變;LL151)

TAILAPI.desc: 尾版比前版少了公開名稱又沒轉接(呼叫端一叫就 AttributeError,Z229)

UNREACH.desc: return/raise/break/continue 之後同一區塊還有陳述式(永遠跑不到)

rules: The panel is read-only: it writes no database, moves no file, fetches nothing, and opens no consent gate.
Python from PowerShell goes through Invoke-VIAPython only; if the helper is missing the panel stops (fail-closed).
Paste back only the yellow block between BEGIN_PASTE and END_PASTE.
Run one command per line; never paste several commands onto one line.
Quote comma lists in PowerShell (--cols "a,b,c"); unquoted a,b,c becomes three arguments.
Engines read the two Taiwan lists through the newest VDF_ENG087 tail, not their own regex or fetcher.
The error matrix only suggests an action; deleting or moving data stays the operator's job (L10).
VIA_Reports outputs are regenerated and never committed.
Run the panel script by its full path from any folder; it resolves every path from its own location.
Line-ending repair restores the repository's bytes only when the difference is line endings alone, and backs up the working copy first.
do_not: run a refresh step that needs the network from the panel
call python directly from the panel script
treat an unverified active ETF as validated
commit a database or a VIA_Reports file
